tools.name: doklado_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the API key can access, optionally filtered by IČO or DIČ. Returns one API unit per call, whatever the count. Use it first to find the organizationId (IČO) for the other tools. Doklado: POST /v3/organization/manage/list.

tools.name: doklado_list_organization_members
tools.description: List the members of one organization. Costs one API unit per call. Doklado: POST /v3/organization/manage/list-members.

tools.name: doklado_list_documents
tools.description: List documents of one organization in a date range. Costs one API unit per document read, before any approval filter. Page with searchAfter: pass the returned searchAfter back unchanged; stop on APP_NO_MORE_DATA. A single request is capped at 2,000 exported documents; narrow dateFrom/dateTo if the c

tools.name: doklado_get_document
tools.description: Get one document by id. Costs one API unit, also on errors. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/get.

tools.name: doklado_get_document_changes
tools.description: Get the change history of up to 10 documents. Costs one API unit per requested document, not per change. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/changes.

tools.name: doklado_get_attachments
tools.description: Get public download links for the attachments of documents. Costs one API unit per document that has attachments, not per file. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/attachments/get.

tools.name: doklado_list_unprocessed_documents
tools.description: List documents in the Unprocessed section of one organization. Costs one API unit per document read. Page with searchAfter. Set limit to 0 for counts only. Doklado: POST /v1/unprocessed-documents.

tools.name: doklado_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions of the organization bound to the API key (no organizationId). Costs one API unit per transaction read. dateType is required when dateFrom or dateTo is set. Page with searchAfter. Doklado: POST /v1/organization/bank-transactions.

tools.name: doklado_set_exported
tools.description: Write the export status of documents, for example after they reached the accounting software. This changes data in the customer's Doklado account. Costs one API unit per document. Doklado: POST /v2/documents/setExported.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: doklado_list_organizations, doklado_list_organization_members, doklado_list_documents, doklado_get_document, doklado_get_document_changes, doklado_get_attachments, doklado_list_unprocessed_documents, doklado_list_bank_transactions · Private data: doklado_list_organizations, doklado_list_documents, doklado_get_document, doklado_get_document_changes, doklado_get_attachments, doklado_list_unprocessed_documents, doklado_list_bank_transactions, doklado_set_exported · Public sink: doklado_list_organizations, doklado_list_organization_members, doklado_list_documents, doklado_get_document, doklado_get_document_changes, doklado_get_attachments, doklado_list_unprocessed_documents, doklado_list_bank_transactions, doklado_set_exported.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: doklado_list_organizations, doklado_list_organization_members, doklado_list_documents, doklado_get_document, doklado_get_document_changes, doklado_get_attachments, doklado_list_unprocessed_documents, doklado_list_bank_transactions · Private data: doklado_list_organizations, doklado_list_documents, doklado_get_document, doklado_get_document_changes, doklado_get_attachments, doklado_list_unprocessed_documents, doklado_list_bank_transactions, doklado_set_exported · Public sink: doklado_list_organizations, doklado_list_organization_members, doklado_list_documents, doklado_get_document, doklado_get_document_changes, doklado_get_attachments, doklado_list_unprocessed_documents, doklado_list_bank_transactions, doklado_set_exported

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
